prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone Kalistar character illustration, portrait 4:5 (ideally 1122 x 1402), edge-to-edge artwork. Absolutely no card frame, words, letters, logos, numbers, stats or UI. Match the supplied Momo and Valazar references: narrative hand-painted fantasy illustration, constructed colour planes, expressive believable anatomy, selective visible oil/gouache brushwork, lost-and-found edges, worn tactile materials, motivated light. Paint the face with colour planes too; no photographic pores, glossy CGI, manga/anime eyes, airbrushed beauty advertising, artificial depth-of-field blur or uniformly applied texture noise. Face and principal action readable in the central 60 percent width, important objects clear of the outer 10 percent, enough breathing room for a later 737 x 921 card illustration crop. The painting is a narrative instant, not a character posing for a camera.
Reference roles: image 1 is Ruby, the retouched existing SIRENA anatomical/species and family reference: humanoid adult upper body with TWO arms and a single coherent scaled mermaid tail instead of legs. Ruby has RED skin and ruby-red scales in this reference; do NOT copy Ruby's colours: Sapphire must have BLUE skin and blue-silver scales. Sapphire is Ruby's sister, NOT a copy of Ruby's happy pose or outfit. Images 2 Momo and 3 Valazar define only the painterly Kalistar style.
Subject and scene: Sapphire, adult warrior princess, daughter of the king of Thalassea, suspended completely underwater before the broad stone entrance of her realm. She has unmistakably BLUE skin, a very powerfully muscled but anatomically believable female physique: strong shoulders, thick athletic upper arms and forearms, solid torso. More physically imposing than Ruby, not a slim model. One elegant small mother-of-pearl royal circlet, long dark blue-black hair moving in the current, a practical dark-steel and pearl scale breastplate covering her chest, exposed muscular arms, modest functional waist armour joining the SAME single broad blue-silver fish tail. Fin-like ears subtly echo Ruby. No human legs or feet hidden beneath the tail. One head, exactly two arms, exactly two hands, exactly one continuous lower-body mermaid tail with a natural two-lobed tail fin.
Narrative instant: she has surged forward to intercept an approaching threat just outside the image. Shoulders squared, both arms OPEN away from her torso, slightly bent elbows keeping both hands visible within the painting. Each hand wears ONE clearly constructed fist gauntlet with three long slender steel claw blades projecting forward from the knuckles, firmly attached, no disconnected blades or fingers turning into extra arms. Her muscular arms, open challenge and confident aggressive grin communicate that she welcomes the fight. Eyes locked on the approaching opponent, not a flirtatious look; energetic protective defiance, no seductive modelling stance. Face, shoulders, both gauntlets and their complete blades must remain visible and unoccluded; open hands/gauntlets within the central 65 percent width, with the elbows bent naturally enough to keep the open-arm pose compact and clear of the side rails. The sweeping tail curves below her and shows underwater propulsion without duplicating its base.
Daylight filtered through the water illuminates the BLUE face and powerful shoulders. Clear turquoise water, restrained caustic light painted as broad broken patches, pearl-grey monumental blocks and a few sea plants receding into simple shapes. No dolphins, no other characters, no treasure clutter or floating decorative orbs. She is entirely underwater, no surface boundary across her body. A vivid narrative painted scene with real tension, not a polished 3D underwater pin-up.
